method: Synthetic independently namespaced copies of the 60 reachable EDA MyLang port modules. All copies called from root entry. Full CLI build wall time, prewarmed runtime/toolchain, fresh frontend and native guest caches for each cold build. Incremental edits retain caches and use unique new source/IR content each time. No release guest builds. Source generation, admission wait, and golden execution validation excluded.

12.reachability: All generated project modules reachable through imports from main; every replica called unconditionally.
